# nrvna

> Unix-like primitives for durable local inference.

`wrk` publishes one independent job. `nrvnad` runs one model against one
workspace. `flw` reads status and results. Context does not continue between
jobs. `--parent` records lineage only.

- [imgsrch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/apps/imgsrch/README.md)
- [imgsrch agent install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sanmathigb/nrvna/main/apps/imgsrch/INSTALL.md)

Use the installed `--help` output for command syntax. The authoritative
filesystem and lifecycle contracts are `include/nrvna/contract.hpp` and
`include/nrvna/lifecycle.hpp`.
